status: Independent CPU review complete; no correctness blocker. Final frozen source hashes match the review. All three wrapper suites pass; model/HTTP qualification remains separate.

findings.bounds: Tile contains 64*33=2112 floats; maximum touched index is 63*33+31=2110. Tail keys use min(32,n-first), including 16 keys at n880. Query count is bounded by the existing <=8192 predicate and new <=3072 range.
findings.synchronization: All 128 threads traverse the same tile iterations and both barriers. The consume-before-reuse barrier also publishes the final scores before max. Nonfinite max returns uniformly; output threads exit only after the final barrier.
findings.numerical: Each key keeps ascending 64-term dot accumulation; max, denominator, expf argument and ascending output accumulation order match the retained kernel. Shared staging adds no floating-point transformation. Compiled parity remains required.
findings.dispatch: Existing full interleaved Q32/KV8/HD64, stride3072 offsets0/2048/2560, no masks/sinks, same-buffer QKV and disjoint-start output checks remain outer guards. Coalesced dispatch adds rows512..3072. New kill0 returns to retained full kernel; outer VISION_ATTN=0 remains scalar.
findings.stream_errors: Launch uses ds4_current_stream and existing cudaGetLastError/cuda_ok contract. No host allocation, persistent device allocation, or new capture-time substrate argument is introduced.
findings.alias: Established alias contract remains unchanged: output and input start pointers differ. Arbitrary partially overlapping tensor views are not newly supported.
findings.resource: Shared bytes=(n+64+2+64*33)*4:12232 at880,21000 at3072, an8448-byte increase per CTA. Total instruction and integer/control work increase despite matching FP math counts.
findings.scope_risk: The same layout is used by images and video; 3072-row image correctness/performance must remain in end-to-end qualification. Larger rows retain the prior kernel.

test_review: Actual wrapper test checks default/ON/OFF, runtime path labels, non-dyadic inputs, 511/512/513 and3071/3072/3073 boundaries, tile-tail879/880/881, invalid max/sum, layouts/masks, guards and input preservation. Its GPU result is tracked separately, not asserted here.
